name: text-split-flap-board
title: Split-flap Board
description: Bảng lật kiểu nhà ga: mỗi ô chữ lật qua vài ký tự trung gian rồi dừng đúng ký tự đích, các ô bắt đầu cách nhau 0.06 giây.

moworks.author: moworks

options.blankAt: s the board clears (3.4; 0.03 s per cell)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after react-bits (MIT + Commons Clause): written from the idea only, no react-bits code

moworks.notes: One card cell per char (≤12 per row, height 1.32 × width, 3 px gap). Each cell starts blank, flips through 3–6 seeded chars of the target's class (A–Z, 0–9, kana), then the target; one flip = top flap rotateX 0 → −90° (ease-in), then the next bottom flap 90° → 0 (ease-out), 85 ms (CSS 85 + 85 ms), perspective 400 px, falling flap darkens to 70 %. Cells start 60 ms apart (capped 1 s) from 0.3 s. Blank again at 3.4 s + 30 ms per cell; loop 4.2 s. Params: flip: mỗi lần lật (0.085 s) · stagger: giữa các ô (0.06 s) · steps: số ký tự trung gian (3–6) · seed.
